description: Read the text of one Pakistani High Court judgment from the judgment_url returned by pk_search_judgments (Islamabad, Sindh, Peshawar or Balochistan). Returns extracted text in pages of max_chars with next_offset; a scanned judgment with no text layer returns found:false rather than an empty string.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (default 0); use next_offset from the previous page.

name: pk_get_judgment
